what_is_already_physically_available.quantity: Signed lower-body total/material/Hu force and holding reaction
what_is_already_physically_available.definition: For body B, F_B^c=-sum_{n in B} f_internal^c[n], c=total/material/regularization. Equivalently negative discrete virtual work on a unit translation of all body DOFs. No boundary stress recovery or new force evaluation is needed.

what_is_already_physically_available.quantity: Discrete body moment about declared centre
what_is_already_physically_available.definition: M_B^c=-sum_n ((x_n-x0) f_internal_y^c[n]-(y_n-y0) f_internal_x^c[n]); use task body centre(71,40)mm for this case. Existing nodal observer has this already. It is a generalized nodal moment, not recovered continuous traction.

what_is_already_physically_available.definition: Existing observer uniquely counts703body nodes with71physical_only,35cut_only,2physical_and_cut,595interior. Its groups conserve the nodal load but do not uniquely allocate corner vectors to incident faces. Boundary geometry is unsigned actualQ1 distance; it is not signed contact pressure or a free-body clamping test.

what_is_already_physically_available.definition: These are captured without extra force calls at accepted states. Future saved-only postprocessing can read them; this review did not decode their NPZ arrays.

existing_peak_observation_not_new_calcul.interpretation: Peak totalFy0.1231794016N remains a signed lower-body weak resultant. At the physical/cut corner group, HuFy6.3705949e-5N and materialFy-5.5311484e-7N have different signs and scales; throwing away the corner or allocating half its vector to each side changes the reported physical picture. Cut-only/interior groups are zero in this particular saved peak, not an assumed identity for arbitrary models.

critical_source_physics.point: Body is a fixed kinematic overlay in the original medium
critical_source_physics.meaning: All incident body ux/uy remain fixed; original phase coefficients are not converted to solid. Saved body cells have F=I,J=1,Hu=P=localforce=0. Sampling stress on the body side would therefore yield zero despite nonzero holding/body load. A material-interface probe must explicitly take the adjacent exterior cell trace and use the body outward reference normal.

critical_source_physics.point: Material P and Hu forces are different weak operators
critical_source_physics.meaning: Material local force is sum_q w_q P_q gradN; regularization local force is k_e H^T Hu with k_e=kr sum_q w_q exp(-5J_q). Saved firstPiola is material P only, while total force retains both terms.

critical_source_physics.point: Do not invent an energy-gradient Piola correction
critical_source_physics.meaning: The source is the declared weak residual. It does not include the extra J-variation material force that would follow from differentiating a proposed scalar0.5*kr*exp(-5J)*|Hu|² energy. Adding such a P term would change the model rather than recover the current total surface force.

critical_source_physics.point: Q1 mixed Hessian is a strong warning against an ordinary Hu pressure field
critical_source_physics.meaning: On these reference rectangles Hxx=Hyy=0 and Hxy=Hyx=[+1,-1,+1,-1]/(hx*hy). Thus each displacement component regularization nodal force has the same alternating corner pattern, with bothxy andyx contractions retained. It annihilates affine virtual fields on a whole cell. Exact discrete Hu bookkeeping can use this pattern, but continuous boundary force recovery additionally needs a declared hyperstress reconstruction, side terms, interelement jumps and corners.

critical_source_physics.point: CurrentC0 broken element Hessian does not supply a unique continuum traction reconstruction
critical_source_physics.meaning: A convenient elementwise mean-coefficient hyperstress reproduces the saved nodal Hu action, with mixed-derivative corner terms on an axis-aligned rectangle. A spatially reconstructed coefficient could instead distribute terms among edges, jumps and volume contributions. These may agree on the Q1 virtual-work basis while giving different pointwise surface plots. The reconstruction choice must be explicit; it is not evidence for a unique total contact pressure.

symmetry_corners_and_effective_grip: The y40 cut is an artificial half-domain boundary, not a physical contact surface. Keep its nodal group and physical/cut endpoints explicit. The existing fullbody mirror relation is F_full=(2Fx,0), whereas2|Fy| is a two-sided magnitude sum; they answer different questions.

Do not simply double all half-body moments: reflect force and lever arm about the common full-body centre, so upper/lower moment parity is treated consistently. The existing nodal moment is already about(71,40) in this saved report.

A physical-physical corner has two incident normals and cannot have one unique normal pressure. Preserve its resultant/corner term instead of arbitrary half-splitting. A physical/cut intersection similarly has two roles.

The current body is fixed in both components and no free-body/friction law is solved. NonzeroFy, smallunsigneddistance and mirrorednormalmagnitude demonstrate load transmission in this constrained experiment; stable grasp of a released body, tangential slip and frictionalholding need later physical task definitions.
